subject: Commercial fit: Seedling Labs - runtime match & license bundle options
messages:
From: Elena Murray <elena.m@seedling.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Seedling Labs Procurement <procurement@seedling.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial quote + runtime questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost breakdown you showed looked promising. Procurement asked me to follow up with the commercial details so we can decide whether to move to a pilot. A couple of specific asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood match the effective $/token economics our incumbent vendor is offering if we commit to a 12-month minimum? They have a blended price with seats + consumption that lands about 35% lower than your list.
2) We need clarity on license bundling: can we convert unused seat capacity to consumption credits mid-term, or are seats strictly non-transferable?
3) If we sign a replacement agreement, what onboarding credits or migration assistance do you typically provide (engineering hours, pilot credits)?

I've attached our incumbent's latest quote for reference (seedling_initial_quote.pdf). Happy to jump on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform Ops
Seedling Labs

Attachments: seedling_initial_quote.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Murray <elena.m@seedling.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial quote + runtime questions

Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. Quick answers up front, then a suggested next step: 

- Price match: we're open to structuring a blended commitment to get to the effective $/token you're seeing, conditional on a 12-month term and a modest onboarding commitment. I need to run a few scenarios with Karthik to confirm exact numbers (seat mix vs. consumption).
- Seat/conversion: we can build a provision to convert unused reserved seats into consumption credits on a quarterly cadence (pro-rata), but that requires explicit language in the contract and a cap (we normally allow up to 40% of committed seat value per quarter to convert).
- Migration assistance: typical packages include pilot credits (up to $50k for this profile), two dedicated onboarding SRE days, and a runbook handoff. For larger migrations we can expand the SRE support.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Monday to align on target effective rate and seat mix, and then we will deliver a redlined counter (I'll attach v3 with the conversion clause). Is Monday 10:00 AM PT OK?

— Priyom
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial quote + runtime questions — quick internal alignment

Folks — forwarding Elena's note and the incumbent quote. Key asks: price-match to incumbent (12-mo), seat -> consumption conversion mid-term, onboarding credits.

My suggested constraints for commercial: 
- Target blended effective savings to seedling: match incumbent within 5% at deal close, with a step-down pricing schedule tied to monthly consumption tiers.
- Conversion clause: allow quarterly conversion up to 40% of committed seat $ value to consumption credits; conversions >40% need leadership signoff.
- Onboarding: offer $35k pilot credit + 2 SRE days in initial counter; escalate to $50k only if they commit to >$500k ARR in 12 months.

Karthik — can you run the model (GPU mix and expected token ratio) and give me two price ladders: (A) aggressive match (hits target within our margin tolerance) and (B) conservative (keeps runway but offers stronger onboarding)?
Jordan — if we agree, I want you on the Monday call to own the renewal/AM ask and to get commitment around 12-mo term vs 24-mo.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Murray <elena.m@seedling.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial quote + runtime questions

Elena — appreciated the time today. Follow-up with our counter highlights and next steps below.

Summary of commercial counter (attached: redwood_counter_terms_v3.docx):
- Effective price: We can match incumbent effective $/token within 3% on a 12-month commitment if Seedling commits to $250k minimum monthly consumption in months 2–12 (or equivalent reserved seat value).
- Seat conversion: Quarterly conversion allowed up to 40% of committed seat $ value into consumption credits; conversions are pro-rata and applied the following quarter. Any single-quarter request above 40% requires executive approval.
- Onboarding & migration: We will provide $35k pilot credits, two dedicated SRE onboarding days, and a migration playbook. If Seedling signs a 24-month term with volume targets (>$750k ARR), we will increase credits to $50k and provide two additional SRE days.
- Other commercial terms: 60-day implementation SLA target for pilot ramp, standard data confidentiality addendum, and a one-time egress assistance credit for large dataset transfer (TBD based on final size).

Requested next steps: 
1) Please review the attached redwood_counter_terms_v3.docx and flag any redlines by Thursday EOD.
2) Confirm whether procurement will accept the quarterly conversion cap or if they require a higher threshold.
3) If the terms look broadly acceptable, we can prepare a signature-ready term sheet and schedule onboarding in mid-August.

Call notes/attachments: redwood_counter_terms_v3.docx (DOCX, 48 KB); HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SDG-4789

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 (555) 210-3344
